en: I've got a Plusle, but what I really want is a Volbeat. Will you trade me one?
A Volbeat! Thanks! Look after Pluses for me, OK?
Huh? That's not a Volbeat. I'm only after a Volbeat.
No? If you ever catch a Volbeat, come back and see me.
Volbeat and I go out every night to watch the lights in the trees. How's my old Pluses doing?
